paper.title: Causal Representation Learning with Optimal Compression under Complex Treatments

claims.name: lemma3_2_generalization_bound
claims.scope: Synthetic empirical risk plus a nonnegative HSIC proxy term.
claims.limitation: The comparison is empirical risk plus a nonnegative term versus empirical risk; population ITE risk and theorem assumptions are absent.

claims.name: theorem3_5_alpha_hat_deviation
claims.scope: Finite HSIC deviations at four sample sizes with fixed assignment logits and effects.
claims.limitation: Alpha-hat, alpha-star, theorem constants, curvature, and confidence are not computed.

claims.name: treatment_aggregation_scaling
claims.scope: Five local timing checks of the explicit dense one-hot HSIC path.
claims.limitation: Small timings do not prove asymptotic learned training complexity in K.

claims.name: theorem3_8_alpha_hat_normality
claims.scope: Finite centered HSIC statistic over 300 seeded trials.
claims.limitation: The statistic is HSIC, not the paper's profile alpha-hat M-estimator.

claims.name: k20_pairwise_vs_aggregation
claims.paper_anchor: K=20 pairwise versus aggregated balancing comparison
claims.scope: Pair enumeration and one aggregate HSIC contrast on synthetic K=20 data.
claims.limitation: PEHE, estimator variance, representation collapse, and the paper's experiment are absent.

claims.name: multi_treatment_causalegm_geodesic_validation
claims.scope: Explicit negative evidence for the missing generative and geodesic pipeline.
claims.limitation: No CausalEGM training, treatment embeddings, image/semi-synthetic data, PEHE, or interpolation implementation is present.
